message.content: In the discussion about Red Dead Redemption 2, Elara shared that her favorite part of the game was the first time she faced off against a legendary beast in "Monster Hunter: World." Elara described the experience as "insane," highlighting the buildup and tension leading up to the battle as "memorable." She mentioned that the sense of accomplishment after defeating the beast was "amazing." However, the final showdown that Elara found particularly unforgettable did not occur in Red Dead Redemption 2 but rather in another game series, specifically "Monster Hunter: World."
